scope: Private IAM-protected UI and private backend implementation only; no deployment, public UI or frozen-context approval

blocking_findings.finding: Bag-of-terms scope check discards relational subjects and comparators. A matching evidence topic and word set authorize canonical affirmative wording for a different proposition.
reproduction: With only GEN003 retrieval hit, query Are mirrors smaller than vehicles? returns SUPPORTED beginning Yes.
Query Are mirrors farther away than vehicles? returns the same affirmative SUPPORTED wording.
Query Do smaller mirrors look farther away? also returns SUPPORTED.
blocking_findings.source_supported_predicate: Vehicles or objects seen in convex mirrors look smaller and farther away compared with a flat mirror; original PDF13.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Guard full proposition roles and request operation, particularly leading Yes/No canonical answers. Use reviewed narrow relation patterns or independently review neutral declarative alternatives; word overlap and reranker rank cannot establish answer/query support.
blocking_findings.gate_limit: Existing exact claim/source checks validate the frozen component's meaning, but do not validate the new affirmative implication created by attaching it to arbitrary input.

positive_findings: Raw arbitrary query reaches candidate and selected dependency retrieval unchanged; no client record or symptom category required.
Singleton selected record retains existing source/applicability/eligibility/dependency/warning/citation and Arm A exact-wording gates; no paid provider calls introduced.
Atomic commit_answer writes session, immutable MotoMedic-specific snapshot and complete operation together before technical SSE is constructed; fixed24h lifetime retained.
Signed high-entropy visitor capability plus backend IAM principal produces distinct owner keys; stable private UI principal-derived nonce preserves counters across new conversations and refreshes.
Identity token is fetched server-side for each request; browser does not receive managed credentials or signing secret.
SSE client checks full saved view before callback, requires complete-event parity, caps aggregate bytes and refuses raw tokens/partial warnings and redirects.
Normal chat input remains available after completed response; typed choices are optional and no diagnostic wizard is required.
concurrent_fixes_rechecked: Session20 precheck added before retrieval; synthetic accepted_turns20 probe returned429 with0 additional retrieval calls.
Operation replay now precedes session saved-view/idle validation; completed initial operation replay remains200 independently of expired session idle deadline.
Stale/invalid choice checks now precede reservation, terminal conflict tracking and operation_terminal error classification added; uncertain commit remains recoverable rather than auto-reexecuted.

independent_validation.command: python -m unittest cloud.arm_a.test_question_wiring rider_ui.tests.test_client rider_ui.tests.test_verified_sse rider_ui.tests.test_identity -v
independent_validation.source_snapshot_note: Coordinator applied fixes during review. This initial37-test run and later targeted probes are not frozen-context closure; rerun latest full suite after scope fix.
independent_validation.false_proposition_probes: Three unsupported affirmative results reproduced despite suite passing.

remaining_limitations: Private UI IAM with invoker checking must be independently verified at deployment; platform_subject decoding does not validate signature itself and cannot authorize a public UI.
Visitor identity is stable per verified private principal, not anonymous-public browser identity; public reset-abuse protection is outside this review.

Admission precheck plus transactional final count protects current single-worker policy; concurrent requests at session quota boundary can still do work before one loses CAS. Broader concurrency needs atomic per-session reservations.
Saved query text is now retained in private session head for feedback; publish that24h retention behavior and keep it out of routine telemetry.
Retained capability expires after24h; ongoing UI session needs clear renewal/reload handling rather than silently resetting visitor counters.
Candidate search with no dependency manifest remains candidate-only and skips conditional reranking for missing review; selected step's dependency retrieval retains original conditional policy.
Conservative arbitrary-input coverage and calibrated query/answer relevance remain unmeasured on independently reviewed heldout queries.
Prepared immutable context, hosted suite, live real retrieval/Firestore/visitor/SSE and fresh-browser acceptance remain required after changes.
